description: BAT46 small-signal Schottky (100 V): a low clipper, between germanium and silicon (our fit to Vishay's sheet)

source.licence: Our own fit to the maker's datasheet curve (D-156): the values are Solum Builder's

rating_sources.if_avg: Vishay BAT46 data sheet, Rev. 2.2, 07-Nov-2024 (doc 85662): Forward continuous current 150 mA
rating_sources.vr_max: Vishay BAT46 data sheet, Rev. 2.2, 07-Nov-2024 (doc 85662): Repetitive peak reverse voltage 100 V

fit.figure: Fig. 1 - Typical Instantaneous Forward Characteristics, Tj = 25 °C (blue), read from the PDF's vector drawing
fit.method: Two diodes in parallel (scripts/fit_models.py fit_diode_pair, D-159): the first fitted, as one diode is, to the points up to 10 mA; the second to the current the points above that carry beyond the first; Both IS held under the sheet's 0.5 µA leakage limit at 1.5 V; CJO is the sheet's typical 10 pF at 0 V; BV 100 V at 100 µA, the sheet's breakdown test, on the first diode
fit.note: Like the BAT41, the curve flattens above 10 mA more than one diode can (95 mV off), so two diodes in parallel (D-159). A subcircuit: its current isn't read at the operating point (D-155)
